Direct and Authentic|Interpretation.recognize: You describe a situation from where you actually stand, without pretending to neutrality, and that honesty is useful. It is also one vantage point presented plainly.
Direct and Authentic|Interpretation.ask: Whose view of this have you not asked for?

Direct and Authentic|Knowledge.recognize: You will say what you do not know, which makes everything else you say reliable. The exposure is announcing a gap in a setting where somebody needed you to be the expert.
Direct and Authentic|Knowledge.ask: Where did your candour undercut you?

Direct and Authentic|Leadership.recognize: Your team sees the real you, including the bad weeks, and they trust the good weeks because of it. The line is that a leader's honesty about strain becomes the team's weather.
Direct and Authentic|Leadership.ask: What did your team carry home from your last hard day?

Direct and Authentic|Mercy.recognize: You do not pretend to be fine around somebody who is not fine, and that shared honesty settles people more than composure would. What it can miss is the person who needed you steady rather than matching.
Direct and Authentic|Mercy.ask: Who needed you solid and got your feelings?

Direct and Authentic|Miracles.recognize: You are honest about what you have and have not seen, so your expectation is never performance. What deserves examining is whether unwilling to overstate has become unwilling to hope out loud.
Direct and Authentic|Miracles.ask: What do you long for that you never say?

Direct and Authentic|Pastor/Shepherd.recognize: People bring you real things because you brought them real things first, and that exchange is where actual care lives. The risk is that your openness sets a pace somebody cannot match.
Direct and Authentic|Pastor/Shepherd.ask: Who has told you more than they meant to?

Direct and Authentic|Prophecy.recognize: You say the true thing about yourself before you say it about anybody else, which is what makes the second one bearable. Where it costs is when the room has to absorb both at once.
Direct and Authentic|Prophecy.ask: How much of your last hard word was about you?

Direct and Authentic|Service.recognize: You state what you are able to take on and what you are not, so nobody has to guess. The friction is that plain limits sound like refusal to people who are used to hedging.
Direct and Authentic|Service.ask: Who heard your no as unwillingness?

Direct and Authentic|Teaching.recognize: You teach out of what you have actually lived rather than the tidy version, and students remember that above the content. The risk is a lesson that is mostly your story.
Direct and Authentic|Teaching.ask: What did they learn that was not about you?

Direct and Authentic|Tongues.recognize: You will not manufacture what you are not feeling, and a room can relax around that. What deserves attention is whether being plain has become your protection.
Direct and Authentic|Tongues.ask: What are you keeping yourself safe from?

Direct and Authentic|Wisdom.recognize: You tell people what it actually cost you, which is the part most advice leaves out. The limit is that the cost was yours and their bill may be different.
Direct and Authentic|Wisdom.ask: What might this cost them that it did not cost you?

Direct and Honest|Administration.recognize: You raise the problem in the process before anybody asks, which is why nothing rots quietly on your watch. What can be missing is that you also raise it in front of whoever built it.
Direct and Honest|Administration.ask: Who built the thing you flagged last week?

Direct and Honest|Apostleship.recognize: You report what the new work is actually like rather than what would keep the funding coming, and that protects everyone downstream. It also makes you the person who dampens things.
Direct and Honest|Apostleship.ask: What did you report that nobody wanted to hear?

Direct and Honest|Discernment.recognize: You bring up what you have noticed about a person rather than sitting on it, and situations get addressed years earlier because of you. The care needed is who you bring it to first.
Direct and Honest|Discernment.ask: Did they hear it from you before anybody else did?

Direct and Honest|Evangelism.recognize: You will raise faith without being asked and without apologising for it, which is rarer than it should be. Watch for the point where offering becomes insisting.
Direct and Honest|Evangelism.ask: Who has heard it from you more than twice?

Direct and Honest|Exhortation.recognize: You say the encouraging thing out loud instead of assuming they know, and people carry those sentences for years. The same habit sends the critical thought out just as quickly.
Direct and Honest|Exhortation.ask: Which of the two arrives first, and how often?

Direct and Honest|Faith.recognize: You state what you believe without being prompted and without softening it for the room, and that plainness steadies people. The danger is a conviction announced before it was ever tested.
Direct and Honest|Faith.ask: What have you stated that you have not lived yet?

Direct and Honest|Giving.recognize: You will put a number in the open when everybody else is being coy, and it frees a room to be honest about money. The cost is the person who now feels measured.
Direct and Honest|Giving.ask: Who felt small after that conversation?

Direct and Honest|Healing.recognize: You say the thing everybody has been avoiding about somebody's condition, and there is relief in having it in the open. What it skips is whether they wanted it opened.
Direct and Honest|Healing.ask: Who was not ready for it to be said?

Direct and Honest|Interpretation.recognize: You offer your read of a confusing situation before anybody requests it, and it usually helps. The risk is that an unrequested reading of somebody's life is still a judgment.
Direct and Honest|Interpretation.ask: What did you explain about somebody that they never asked you to?

Direct and Honest|Knowledge.recognize: You pass on what you know instead of holding it for advantage, and whole teams are better informed because of you. The exposure is information that was not yours to pass on.
Direct and Honest|Knowledge.ask: What did you share that had been told to you privately?

Direct and Honest|Leadership.recognize: Your people hear the bad news from you first and they hear it straight, which is why they follow you through hard seasons. What it can cost is the person who needed that news privately.
Direct and Honest|Leadership.ask: What did you announce that should have been a conversation?

Direct and Honest|Mercy.recognize: You will say out loud that somebody is suffering when the room is pretending otherwise, and that naming is often the kindest act available. Some people were doing the pretending on purpose.

Direct and Honest|Miracles.recognize: You report exactly what you saw, no more and no less, and that reliability is why people believe your accounts. The cost is being the one who deflates a good story.
Direct and Honest|Miracles.ask: Whose account did you correct, and how did that go?

Direct and Honest|Pastor/Shepherd.recognize: You go to the person and say the thing rather than letting it sit for a year, and situations get resolved that would otherwise have festered. The risk is arriving with the matter already decided.
Direct and Honest|Pastor/Shepherd.ask: Did you go with a question or a conclusion?

Direct and Honest|Prophecy.recognize: You do not wait to be asked. That is the whole gift and the whole exposure in one sentence. What deserves weighing is how often the word was requested by anybody, including God.
Direct and Honest|Prophecy.ask: What have you delivered that you were not sent with?

Direct and Honest|Service.recognize: You will say what the job actually needs, including that it needs more people, rather than quietly absorbing it, and that keeps ministries from burning out. It also makes you the one always raising problems.
Direct and Honest|Service.ask: How do you sound to somebody who only hears you at meetings?

Direct and Honest|Teaching.recognize: You correct the error in front of you instead of letting it pass, and your students end up with accurate foundations. The risk is that a class where every mistake is named goes quiet.
Direct and Honest|Teaching.ask: Who has stopped guessing out loud?

Direct and Honest|Tongues.recognize: You say plainly what you experience and what you do not, which stops a room from pretending together. What can settle in is being known mainly for what you are against.
Direct and Honest|Tongues.ask: What are you for that people would name as easily?

Direct and Honest|Wisdom.recognize: You give the answer as you actually see it rather than the diplomatic version, and people can act on that. The limit is that a hard answer given early is often not received at all.
Direct and Honest|Wisdom.ask: What good advice of yours went nowhere?

Disciplined|Administration.recognize: The thing runs on time because you run it on time, every week, without variation. What can be missing is that the schedule now serves itself and nobody has asked whether it still fits.
Disciplined|Administration.ask: When did you last change how this runs?

Disciplined|Apostleship.recognize: You bring shape into a new work that would otherwise be chaos, and that is often what lets it survive year two. The risk is imposing year-five structure in month two.
Disciplined|Apostleship.ask: What did you formalise before it was ready?

Disciplined|Discernment.recognize: You have a consistent read on people because you apply the same standard to everybody, and that fairness is real. It also means somebody who does not fit the standard gets read wrong.
Disciplined|Discernment.ask: Who does not fit your usual categories?

Disciplined|Evangelism.recognize: You do the follow-up nobody else does, at the interval you said you would, and people come back because somebody actually called. Watch for a process so orderly that the person becomes a stage in it.
Disciplined|Evangelism.ask: Where is that person in your system right now?

Disciplined|Exhortation.recognize: You check in on the same schedule regardless of how you feel about it, and reliability lifts people more than intensity does. The gap is the crisis that does not fall on a Tuesday.

Disciplined|Faith.recognize: Your practices hold when your feelings do not, which is what carries most believers through their worst years. The check is whether the practice is still a meeting or has become a record.
Disciplined|Faith.ask: When did your devotions last surprise you?

Disciplined|Giving.recognize: You give the same amount at the same time and you have never once missed, and over twenty years that is an enormous sum quietly delivered. What is rarer for you is the unbudgeted yes.
Disciplined|Giving.ask: When did you last give without planning to?

Disciplined|Healing.recognize: You show up at the hospital every Thursday for as long as it takes, and consistency is what most recovery actually needs. What can be missed is the Wednesday it all fell apart.
Disciplined|Healing.ask: Do they know they can call between visits?

Disciplined|Interpretation.recognize: You work through a confusing situation the same orderly way every time and you usually arrive somewhere sound. The risk is a method that cannot accommodate a situation shaped differently.
Disciplined|Interpretation.ask: What did not fit your usual approach?

Disciplined|Knowledge.recognize: You study at the same hour in the same way and have accumulated more than people far quicker than you. The waste is the material you keep covering because it is on the plan.
Disciplined|Knowledge.ask: What are you still studying out of habit?

Disciplined|Leadership.recognize: Your team knows exactly what is expected and nothing shifts underneath them, which is worth more than inspiration most weeks. The exposure is what happens when the situation changes and the expectations do not.
Disciplined|Leadership.ask: What rule of yours no longer fits?

Disciplined|Mercy.recognize: You keep turning up for somebody long after the sympathy of others ran out, on a schedule, regardless. The limit is that grief is not orderly and may need you at the wrong hour.
Disciplined|Mercy.ask: When were you last inconvenienced by somebody's pain?

Disciplined|Miracles.recognize: You pray at the same time every day whether anything is happening or not, and that persistence is exactly the posture Scripture describes. Worth asking is whether you would recognise an answer that arrived off schedule.
Disciplined|Miracles.ask: What might God have done that you filed as coincidence?

Disciplined|Pastor/Shepherd.recognize: Nobody in your care falls through, because you work the list and the list is complete. What the list cannot hold is the person whose need does not fit a column.
Disciplined|Pastor/Shepherd.ask: Who is fine on paper and not fine?

Disciplined|Prophecy.recognize: You hold the standard steadily rather than only when provoked, so when you speak it is not a reaction. The cost is that a standard held this consistently can become the only thing people hear from you.

Disciplined|Service.recognize: You do the job the same way every time and it is done properly every time, and whole operations rest on people like you. The friction is with the person who does it differently and just as well.
Disciplined|Service.ask: Whose different method have you corrected?

Disciplined|Teaching.recognize: You cover the material completely and in order, so your students actually finish with the whole of it. The risk is the question that arrives in week two about week nine.
Disciplined|Teaching.ask: What question did you defer that they needed answered?

Disciplined|Tongues.recognize: You practise this whether or not anything is happening, and that steadiness keeps it from being about atmosphere. What can settle in is form without anticipation.
Disciplined|Tongues.ask: What do you look for when you begin?

Disciplined|Wisdom.recognize: Your advice is consistent, so people can predict what you will say and often act before they ask. The limit is the situation where your usual answer is the wrong one.
Disciplined|Wisdom.ask: When did you last give unusual advice?

Easygoing|Administration.recognize: Nothing rattles you when the plan changes, so you are the person who keeps a system running through disruption. What can slip is the deadline that needed somebody to be worried about it.
Easygoing|Administration.ask: What is late that nobody is anxious about?

Easygoing|Apostleship.recognize: You can live with the mess of a new work for as long as it takes, and most new works are mess for years. The risk is that mess you have made peace with stops looking like a problem.
Easygoing|Apostleship.ask: What have you accepted that should be fixed?

Easygoing|Discernment.recognize: You do not rush to conclusions about people, so your reads are rarely unfair. The cost is that a concern you never quite got around to raising is still a concern.
Easygoing|Discernment.ask: What have you let slide about somebody?

Easygoing|Evangelism.recognize: People talk to you because nothing about you is a campaign, and that gets you into conversations the eager never reach. Watch for a comfort with waiting that has now lasted eleven years.
Easygoing|Evangelism.ask: Who have you been meaning to talk to?

Easygoing|Exhortation.recognize: You take the pressure off people, and for somebody crushed under expectation that is exactly the word from God. The gap is the person who needed to be pressed a little.
Easygoing|Exhortation.ask: Who did you let off the hook too early?

Easygoing|Faith.recognize: You are not anxious about outcomes, which looks like trust and often is. Worth checking is how much of it is simply not minding much either way.
Easygoing|Faith.ask: What are you actually contending for?

Easygoing|Giving.recognize: You give without agonising over it, and that lightness keeps money from getting a grip on you. What can go missing is the deliberate gift that required a plan.
Easygoing|Giving.ask: What could you give if you planned for it?

Easygoing|Healing.recognize: People in pain can breathe around you because you are not managing them or fixing them, and that is real medicine. What it can become is presence with no movement in it.
Easygoing|Healing.ask: Who has been comfortable and stuck with you for a year?

Easygoing|Interpretation.recognize: You do not need a situation resolved to be at peace with it, so you can hold ambiguity while other people panic. The risk is leaving something unexplained that they needed explained.
Easygoing|Interpretation.ask: What confusion have you been content to leave?

Easygoing|Knowledge.recognize: You learn what interests you without the pressure of having to master it, and you know a surprising amount. The waste is how far you could have gone in one thing.
Easygoing|Knowledge.ask: What would you know by now if you had stayed with it?

Easygoing|Leadership.recognize: Your team is not afraid of you and they tell you things other leaders never hear. The exposure is that a team who is never pushed rarely finds out what it could have done.
Easygoing|Leadership.ask: When did you last ask your team for more?

Easygoing|Mercy.recognize: You accept people exactly as they arrive, which is why they arrive. The limit is that acceptance with no expectation attached can leave somebody precisely where they were.
Easygoing|Mercy.ask: Who has felt accepted by you and unchanged?

Easygoing|Miracles.recognize: You are at peace whether or not something dramatic happens, and that keeps a room from manufacturing anything. What is worth examining is whether you are asking for much at all.
Easygoing|Miracles.ask: What have you asked God for this year?

Easygoing|Pastor/Shepherd.recognize: People stay in your care because it costs them nothing to be there, and that low bar is why some of them are there at all. The risk is care that asks nothing and therefore grows nobody.
Easygoing|Pastor/Shepherd.ask: Who has been with you for years and not moved?

Easygoing|Prophecy.recognize: You are hard to provoke, so when something does bother you enough to speak, it carries. The cost is how much passes first.
Easygoing|Prophecy.ask: What has been bothering you for months?

Easygoing|Service.recognize: You will do whatever is needed without needing it defined, and you never complain about the job you got. What can slip is the job that needed somebody to insist it be done properly.
Easygoing|Service.ask: What did you accept that was not good enough?

Easygoing|Teaching.recognize: Your class is a place people are not afraid to be wrong in, and that is where most learning actually happens. The risk is a class that is comfortable and changes nobody.
Easygoing|Teaching.ask: What has anybody done differently since?

Easygoing|Tongues.recognize: You are at ease with what you cannot explain and you do not need it to make sense. The examination is whether that ease has replaced any hunger.
Easygoing|Tongues.ask: What do you want from God right now?

Easygoing|Wisdom.recognize: You are unhurried, so people bring you things early, before they are a crisis. The limit is that some early things needed to be treated as urgent.
Easygoing|Wisdom.ask: What did you take calmly that turned into a crisis?

Efficient Organizer|Administration.recognize: You can take a process from eleven steps to four and nothing is lost, and whole teams get their afternoons back. What can go with those seven steps is the slack that let somebody catch a mistake.
Efficient Organizer|Administration.ask: What used to get caught that now goes straight through?

Efficient Organizer|Apostleship.recognize: You get a new work operational fast, because you know what can be skipped at the start. The exposure is that some of what you skipped was the part that would have held it together in year three.
Efficient Organizer|Apostleship.ask: What did you defer that is now overdue?

Efficient Organizer|Discernment.recognize: You sort quickly who is going to deliver and who is not, and you are usually right. The cost falls on the person who was slow for a reason you never asked about.
Efficient Organizer|Discernment.ask: Who did you write off without knowing what they were carrying?

Efficient Organizer|Evangelism.recognize: You get people from first conversation to actually showing up, because you removed every obstacle between the two. Watch for a pathway so smooth that nobody has to decide anything.
Efficient Organizer|Evangelism.ask: What did somebody have to give up to follow Christ through your process?

Efficient Organizer|Exhortation.recognize: You give people the shortest route to what they are trying to do, and that is a real kindness to somebody stuck. The gap is the person whose slowness was the work itself.
Efficient Organizer|Exhortation.ask: Whose long way round did you cut short?

Efficient Organizer|Faith.recognize: You clear the practical obstacles so obedience is possible rather than theoretical, and that has moved real things forward. The check is whether anything in your life still requires God.
Efficient Organizer|Faith.ask: What are you doing right now that has no plan behind it?

Efficient Organizer|Giving.recognize: Your generosity is well routed, low overhead, and reaches further per dollar than most. What can be lost is the wasteful gift that mattered because it was wasteful.
Efficient Organizer|Giving.ask: What would you give if it did not have to make sense?

Efficient Organizer|Healing.recognize: You remove the practical burdens around somebody in crisis, the meals, the paperwork, the ride, and that is often what makes recovery possible. What it can skip is the slow conversation that nothing schedules.
Efficient Organizer|Healing.ask: When did you last sit down there with no task in hand?

Efficient Organizer|Interpretation.recognize: You reduce a tangled situation to the two things that actually matter, and people can move again. The risk is that the third thing you cut was the one carrying the pain.
Efficient Organizer|Interpretation.ask: What did you leave out of the short version?

Efficient Organizer|Knowledge.recognize: You find the fastest route to an answer and you do not gather what you will not use. The waste is the finding that would only have arrived on the long route.
Efficient Organizer|Knowledge.ask: What have you never learned because it was not on the way?

Efficient Organizer|Leadership.recognize: Your team wastes nothing, because you removed everything that was not load-bearing. The exposure is that people are not systems and the part you trimmed was their margin.
Efficient Organizer|Leadership.ask: Who on your team has no room left?

Efficient Organizer|Mercy.recognize: You meet the practical needs around suffering faster than anybody, and that is real care. The limit is that grief is wasteful by nature and cannot be shortened.
Efficient Organizer|Mercy.ask: Who did you try to move through it?

Efficient Organizer|Miracles.recognize: You have arranged your life so the resources are ready when God says go, and that is faithfulness. Worth examining is whether you would go without them ready.
Efficient Organizer|Miracles.ask: What would you do if the resources never came?

Efficient Organizer|Pastor/Shepherd.recognize: You can care for more people than most because you have a method for it, and nobody falls through. What a method cannot do is give somebody unhurried time.
Efficient Organizer|Pastor/Shepherd.ask: When did you last lose track of the hour with somebody?

Efficient Organizer|Prophecy.recognize: You say the hard thing in the fewest words, so it is unmistakable. The cost is that brevity leaves no room for the person to be a person while hearing it.
Efficient Organizer|Prophecy.ask: What did you say in a sentence that needed a conversation?

Efficient Organizer|Service.recognize: You reorganise the work so six volunteers do what took fifteen, and everybody goes home earlier. The friction is with the nine who came to be useful and were not needed.
Efficient Organizer|Service.ask: Who got sent home who wanted to stay?

Efficient Organizer|Teaching.recognize: You cut a subject down to what a person actually needs and they get it in half the time. The risk is that what you removed was the part that would have made it stick.
Efficient Organizer|Teaching.ask: What did you cut that they later needed?

Efficient Organizer|Tongues.recognize: You are practical about this rather than precious, and that keeps it from becoming theatre. What can happen is treating unhurried time as time badly spent.
Efficient Organizer|Tongues.ask: How long can you stay in something with no result?

Efficient Organizer|Wisdom.recognize: You hand people the decision rather than the deliberation, and busy people are grateful for it. The limit is that some choices are only understood by working slowly through them.
Efficient Organizer|Wisdom.ask: Whose thinking did you do for them?

Empathetic|Administration.recognize: You build the process around how people will actually feel using it, which is why yours get adopted and other people's get ignored. What can slip is that the requirement everybody dislikes is sometimes the necessary one.
Empathetic|Administration.ask: What rule have you softened because of how it landed?

Empathetic|Apostleship.recognize: You can tell within an hour what a new community actually needs rather than what the brochure said, which is why new work in your hands fits the place. The exposure is that you take on its weight as your own.
Empathetic|Apostleship.ask: What are you carrying from there that is not yours?

Empathetic|Discernment.recognize: You know somebody is not all right before there is anything to point at, and you are seldom wrong. The care needed is telling apart what you picked up from them and what you brought in yourself.

Empathetic|Evangelism.recognize: People tell you the real thing in the first conversation, so you are talking about what matters while others are still on the weather. Watch for feeling their resistance so strongly that you never ask.
Empathetic|Evangelism.ask: Who did you understand deeply and never ask?

Empathetic|Exhortation.recognize: You know exactly what somebody needs to hear because you can feel where they are, and it lands every time. The gap is the person who needed you unmoved by their discouragement.
Empathetic|Exhortation.ask: Who needed you to disagree with how they feel?

Empathetic|Faith.recognize: You are moved by what God is doing in a room, and that is not nothing. The check is what happens across the long stretch where nothing is felt at all.
Empathetic|Faith.ask: What do you do on the days you feel nothing?

Empathetic|Giving.recognize: You give to the need you have felt rather than the one on the list, and it is usually the one that mattered. The exposure is that whoever reaches you first gets everything.

Empathetic|Healing.recognize: You go where the pain is and you do not need it explained, which is the whole beginning of it for most people. What follows is that you carry it home.
Empathetic|Healing.ask: What have you still not put down from last year?

Empathetic|Interpretation.recognize: You can say what somebody meant underneath what they said, and they feel found. The risk is that your reading is confident and they may not have meant that at all.
Empathetic|Interpretation.ask: When did you last check your reading with them?

Empathetic|Knowledge.recognize: You know things about people that were never told to you, and you know them accurately. What deserves examining is how much of that you should be holding.
Empathetic|Knowledge.ask: What do you know that you would rather not?

Empathetic|Leadership.recognize: Your team knows you can tell when they are struggling, and they stay because of it. The exposure is that a leader who feels everything the team feels cannot hold the line when the team is wrong.
Empathetic|Leadership.ask: When did you last hold a decision your team hated?

Empathetic|Mercy.recognize: You do not have to imagine what somebody is going through because you are already in it with them, and nobody in your presence is alone. The limit is that a person in deep water needs somebody standing on the bank.
Empathetic|Mercy.ask: Who needed you outside it rather than in it?

Empathetic|Miracles.recognize: You can feel when a room has shifted, and you are usually right about it. What to check is whether feeling and happening have become the same thing to you.
Empathetic|Miracles.ask: What did you feel that turned out to be only feeling?

Empathetic|Pastor/Shepherd.recognize: You know how every person in your care is doing, which is remarkable at any number above ten. The cost is a week where four of them are in crisis and you are in all four.
Empathetic|Pastor/Shepherd.ask: How many people's weeks are you living right now?

Empathetic|Prophecy.recognize: You can say the hard thing without destroying the person, because you feel it landing as you say it. What that can produce is a word softened past the point of use.
Empathetic|Prophecy.ask: What did you hold back to spare them?

Empathetic|Service.recognize: You do the thing somebody needed without them having to ask, because you noticed the need in the room. The strain is doing it for everybody in the room, every week.
Empathetic|Service.ask: What are you doing for people who could do it themselves?

Empathetic|Teaching.recognize: You can tell the moment a room stops following and you change course before anybody raises a hand. The risk is teaching for comfort and never letting a room sit in difficulty.
Empathetic|Teaching.ask: When did you last let students struggle?

Empathetic|Tongues.recognize: You are at home in what is felt rather than explained, which is exactly the ground this occupies. What deserves attention is whether your own state has become the measure of whether God is present.
Empathetic|Tongues.ask: Was He there on the flat days too?

Empathetic|Wisdom.recognize: People bring you decisions because you understand what they actually want, not only what they asked. The limit is that being fully inside their position makes it hard to say what they will not like.
Empathetic|Wisdom.ask: What advice have you not given because it would hurt?

Energetic|Administration.recognize: You get a stalled system moving again by sheer output, and things that sat for months clear in a week. What follows is the upkeep, which needs a different sort of person and often does not have one.
Energetic|Administration.ask: Who keeps it going after your week is over?

Energetic|Apostleship.recognize: New work needs somebody who can go at it hard for two years with nothing visible in return, and that is you. The risk is that the pace you set becomes the entry requirement for everyone who joins.
Energetic|Apostleship.ask: Who could not keep up and left?

Energetic|Discernment.recognize: You are quick to read a situation and quicker to move on it, and momentum is often exactly what was missing. The care needed is that a fast read on a person is still a first read.
Energetic|Discernment.ask: Who deserves a second look from you?

Energetic|Evangelism.recognize: Your enthusiasm is real and people can tell, which opens doors that polish never opens. Watch for filling a conversation so completely that the other person never speaks.
Energetic|Evangelism.ask: How much did they say last time?

Energetic|Exhortation.recognize: You can lift a whole room in ten minutes, and some rooms desperately need that. The gap is the person who was not tired, they were grieving.

Energetic|Faith.recognize: You throw yourself fully at what you believe God is doing, and that wholeheartedness is rare. The check is whether you can stay in a season where He asks you to do nothing.
Energetic|Faith.ask: What has God asked you to wait on?

Energetic|Giving.recognize: You will give time, effort and money at a rate few people sustain, and things get built because of it. The exposure is giving out of reserves you do not have.
Energetic|Giving.ask: What did you commit to this month while already stretched?

Energetic|Healing.recognize: You bring life into a room that has gone still, and for somebody sunk in a long illness your visit is the high point of the week. What it can miss is that they may need you slower.
Energetic|Healing.ask: Whose pace should you have matched?

Energetic|Interpretation.recognize: You work through a confusing situation at speed and come out with something usable while others are still framing the question. The risk is a reading you settled in ten minutes and never revisited.
Energetic|Interpretation.ask: What conclusion have you never gone back to?

Energetic|Knowledge.recognize: You pick things up quickly and go at a new subject hard, and you are useful on it within days. The waste is the six subjects you were useful on and then dropped.
Energetic|Knowledge.ask: What did you take up hard and put down entirely?

Energetic|Leadership.recognize: Your team moves because you are moving, and there is no substitute for that in a slow organisation. The exposure is that they cannot tell you they are spent, because you never look it.
Energetic|Leadership.ask: Who is running on empty and still showing up?

Energetic|Mercy.recognize: You will drive four hours and be there the same night, and turning up like that is most of what this is. The limit is that intensity comes easier to you than the long quiet part.
Energetic|Mercy.ask: Who did you help once and never revisit?

Energetic|Miracles.recognize: You act on what you believe God will do rather than waiting to see, and that active anticipation is where a great deal happens. Watch for effort quietly substituting for the asking.
Energetic|Miracles.ask: What are you working at that you should be praying for?

Energetic|Pastor/Shepherd.recognize: You can care for a lot of people at once because you have the capacity for it, and few do. The cost is that when you run out, everybody runs out at the same moment.
Energetic|Pastor/Shepherd.ask: What happens to your people when you crash?

Energetic|Prophecy.recognize: You say what needs saying with force, and force is sometimes exactly what a complacent room requires. The cost is that volume and weight get confused, by them and by you.
Energetic|Prophecy.ask: What did you deliver loudly that needed to be quiet?

Energetic|Service.recognize: You do the work of three people and the job gets finished. What deserves attention is that a team built around one person's output never learns to carry its own.
Energetic|Service.ask: What would not happen if you took a month off?

Energetic|Teaching.recognize: Nobody sleeps in your class and people come back for the second session. The risk is a room carried by your delivery, which cannot reproduce the content without you.
Energetic|Teaching.ask: Could somebody teach it from their notes?

Energetic|Tongues.recognize: You bring everything you have into it and hold nothing back, which is what this actually asks for. What can happen is measuring the encounter by how much you put in.
Energetic|Tongues.ask: What is left when the energy is gone?

Energetic|Wisdom.recognize: You will work a problem until it gives, and effort does solve a great many things. The limit is the situation where doing less is the answer and you have no practice at it.
Energetic|Wisdom.ask: Where would doing nothing be the right move?

Enjoy Creating Order|Administration.recognize: You leave every system you touch cleaner than you found it, and whoever comes after you inherits something that works. Worth asking is whether the mess was in the way or only in view.
Enjoy Creating Order|Administration.ask: What did you straighten that nobody was struggling with?

Enjoy Creating Order|Apostleship.recognize: A new work throws off clutter faster than anybody can file it, and you are the reason it does not become unmanageable. The risk is putting things in their place before anybody knows what the places are.
Enjoy Creating Order|Apostleship.ask: What is now fixed that should still be open?

Enjoy Creating Order|Discernment.recognize: You sort people and situations into categories quickly, and the categories are usually right. The cost is the person who belongs in two of them, or in none.

Enjoy Creating Order|Evangelism.recognize: You build a clear path from first visit to belonging, and people who would have drifted instead stay. Watch for a path so defined that anybody arriving sideways cannot find the entrance.
Enjoy Creating Order|Evangelism.ask: Who does not fit your pathway?

Enjoy Creating Order|Exhortation.recognize: You help people see the sequence of what to do next, and a confused person handed a sequence can move again. The gap is that some situations do not come in steps.
Enjoy Creating Order|Exhortation.ask: Whose mess did you hand a plan when they needed presence?

Enjoy Creating Order|Faith.recognize: You give your life a shape that makes obedience routine rather than heroic, and that shape holds when feelings do not. The check is whether God is permitted to disrupt it.
Enjoy Creating Order|Faith.ask: When did you last change your plans because of a prompting?

Enjoy Creating Order|Giving.recognize: Your generosity is planned, recorded and never late, which funds what unreliable giving cannot. What is rarer is the gift that breaks the pattern.
Enjoy Creating Order|Giving.ask: What was the last gift that broke your pattern?

Enjoy Creating Order|Healing.recognize: You bring calm to a chaotic situation by putting things back where they belong, and for a family in crisis that is enormous. What it can skip is that the disorder was theirs to sit in for a while.
Enjoy Creating Order|Healing.ask: Whose chaos did you clear up too soon?

Enjoy Creating Order|Interpretation.recognize: You lay a confusing situation out so people can see its parts, and seeing the parts is most of understanding it. The risk is that a neat layout implies a neatness the situation does not have.
Enjoy Creating Order|Interpretation.ask: What did your version make look simpler than it is?

Enjoy Creating Order|Knowledge.recognize: You keep what you know in a form you can retrieve, so it is actually available rather than vaguely remembered. The waste is whatever would not fit a category and got dropped.
Enjoy Creating Order|Knowledge.ask: What have you discarded because it would not file?

Enjoy Creating Order|Leadership.recognize: Everybody knows their role, the meeting starts on time, and the work gets done, which is not a small thing. The exposure is that structure this good hides whether anybody believes in it.

Enjoy Creating Order|Mercy.recognize: You do the practical putting-right around somebody's suffering, and practical help is love in a form people can use. The limit is that a life cannot be put back where it was.
Enjoy Creating Order|Mercy.ask: What have you been trying to return to normal that will not?

Enjoy Creating Order|Miracles.recognize: You prepare thoroughly for what you are asking God to do, and preparation is a form of faith. Worth examining is whether an answer that ignored your preparation would even be recognised.
Enjoy Creating Order|Miracles.ask: What would you do with an unplanned yes?

Enjoy Creating Order|Pastor/Shepherd.recognize: Nobody in your care is forgotten, because your records are complete and your rhythm is regular. What a record cannot show is the person whose crisis has no category yet.
Enjoy Creating Order|Pastor/Shepherd.ask: Who is not on any list?

Enjoy Creating Order|Prophecy.recognize: You name what is out of place clearly, and clear naming is how things get put right. The cost is that people can start to feel like items being straightened.
Enjoy Creating Order|Prophecy.ask: Who feels corrected by you more than known?

Enjoy Creating Order|Service.recognize: You leave a room, a kitchen or a job in better order than you found it, every time, without being asked. The friction is with people who work well in a state you would not tolerate.
Enjoy Creating Order|Service.ask: Whose way of working have you quietly redone?

Enjoy Creating Order|Teaching.recognize: Your material is sequenced so each week rests on the last, and students actually build something. The risk is the question from the back row that does not fit this week.
Enjoy Creating Order|Teaching.ask: What good question have you postponed?

Enjoy Creating Order|Tongues.recognize: You give this a regular place in your life rather than leaving it to occasion, and that steadiness sustains it. What can settle in is preferring the form to whatever it was for.
Enjoy Creating Order|Tongues.ask: What would you do if it stopped fitting the schedule?

Enjoy Creating Order|Wisdom.recognize: You help people see their situation laid out, and half of good advice is exactly that. The limit is that some decisions are made in the dark and no layout will light them.
Enjoy Creating Order|Wisdom.ask: What choice of yours never became clear?

Enthusiastic|Administration.recognize: You make people want to be part of the work, so rosters fill that would otherwise sit empty. What follows is the week four problem, when the excitement has gone and the job is still there.
Enthusiastic|Administration.ask: How many of your recruits are still serving?

Enthusiastic|Apostleship.recognize: You can make a place that has nothing sound worth going to, and that is how new work gets its first people. The risk is that they came for the version you described.
Enthusiastic|Apostleship.ask: What did they expect that they did not find?

Enthusiastic|Discernment.recognize: You see what somebody could become almost immediately, and often you are right about it. The care needed is that potential is not the same as readiness.
Enthusiastic|Discernment.ask: Who did you put forward before they were ready?

Enthusiastic|Evangelism.recognize: Your delight in this is obvious and undisguised, and delight persuades where argument does not. Watch for the person who needed room to be uncertain and got your certainty.
Enthusiastic|Evangelism.ask: Who backed away from how keen you were?

Enthusiastic|Exhortation.recognize: You get people believing they can do the thing, and belief is usually the missing part. The gap is that you can talk somebody into a commitment that was really yours.
Enthusiastic|Exhortation.ask: Whose yes came out of your excitement?

Enthusiastic|Faith.recognize: You respond to God quickly and wholly, and that responsiveness is what most people are missing. The check is what your faith looks like in a season with nothing to respond to.

Enthusiastic|Giving.recognize: You give in the moment you are moved, and that spontaneity meets needs a budget never reaches. The exposure is a promise made warmly that has to be kept coldly.
Enthusiastic|Giving.ask: What did you pledge that you are struggling to pay?

Enthusiastic|Healing.recognize: You bring real hope into a room that has run out of it, and hope is medicine. What it can miss is that somebody deep in it may need you to sit in the dark with them first.
Enthusiastic|Healing.ask: Who was not ready to hear that it gets better?

Enthusiastic|Interpretation.recognize: You can make what somebody is going through sound like it counts for something, and that is what they were looking for. The risk is finding a purpose in it before they have finished being angry.
Enthusiastic|Interpretation.ask: Who needed you to say it was simply bad?

Enthusiastic|Knowledge.recognize: You are excited by what you learn and that makes other people want to know it too. The waste is the twelve things you were excited about that went nowhere.
Enthusiastic|Knowledge.ask: What are you excited about now, and will it survive March?

Enthusiastic|Leadership.recognize: People will follow you into something new because you make it sound possible, and possible is most of starting. The exposure is a team who cannot tell you the thing is not working.
Enthusiastic|Leadership.ask: Who has bad news for you and has not said it?

Enthusiastic|Mercy.recognize: You go toward hurting people gladly rather than out of duty, and they can feel the difference. The limit is that your presence can ask something of them they do not have.
Enthusiastic|Mercy.ask: Who had to perform being helped?

Enthusiastic|Miracles.recognize: You look for God to move and you are not embarrassed about it, which is why rooms with you in them stay open. Worth watching is what you do with the ones where nothing came.

Enthusiastic|Pastor/Shepherd.recognize: People feel wanted around you, and feeling wanted is why most of them stay. The cost is the quiet person who finds that warmth a great deal to be met with.
Enthusiastic|Pastor/Shepherd.ask: Who takes a step back when you approach?

Enthusiastic|Prophecy.recognize: You can deliver a hard word with such evident care that people are able to receive it. The risk is that your warmth carries it so well the weight never arrives.
Enthusiastic|Prophecy.ask: Did they leave convicted or encouraged?

Enthusiastic|Service.recognize: You make the work feel like something worth doing, and volunteers turn up for that as much as for the job. What can slip is the unglamorous stretch that no amount of energy improves.
Enthusiastic|Service.ask: What part of the job does nobody come back for?

Enthusiastic|Teaching.recognize: Your students catch your interest in the subject, and interest outlasts information. The risk is a room that loved the hour and cannot say what it was about.

Enthusiastic|Tongues.recognize: You come into this expectant and unguarded, which is the posture it asks for. What deserves attention is whether the encounter is being measured by intensity.
Enthusiastic|Tongues.ask: What was the last quiet one like?

Enthusiastic|Wisdom.recognize: People come to you because you take their situation seriously and treat it as solvable. The limit is that some things are not solvable, and hearing that they are is a burden.
Enthusiastic|Wisdom.ask: Whose unsolvable thing did you try to fix?

Excellent Brainstormers|Administration.recognize: You can produce fifteen ways to run the thing in an afternoon, and one of them is better than what exists. The cost is that the other fourteen have to be worked through by somebody.
Excellent Brainstormers|Administration.ask: Who does the sorting after you have finished?

Excellent Brainstormers|Apostleship.recognize: A new work needs somebody who can see twenty possible shapes for it, and that is you. The risk is that the group is still weighing shape four when you are on nineteen.
Excellent Brainstormers|Apostleship.ask: What did the team never get to decide?

Excellent Brainstormers|Discernment.recognize: You hold several readings of a person at once rather than settling on the first, which keeps you from being unfair. The care needed is that a person can feel the difference between being understood and being theorised about.
Excellent Brainstormers|Discernment.ask: Who have you been working out rather than knowing?

Excellent Brainstormers|Evangelism.recognize: You find an angle for every person because you can come up with ten, and one usually fits. Watch for enjoying the puzzle of a person more than their answer.
Excellent Brainstormers|Evangelism.ask: Who became a project to you rather than a friend?

Excellent Brainstormers|Exhortation.recognize: You give people options they had not considered, and somebody who felt trapped can move again. The gap is that six options for a person already swamped is one more weight.
Excellent Brainstormers|Exhortation.ask: Who needed one direction and got a menu?

Excellent Brainstormers|Faith.recognize: You can imagine many ways God might work here, and that keeps you from a small view of Him. The check is whether the possibilities have become a substitute for asking Him which one.
Excellent Brainstormers|Faith.ask: What have you been speculating about instead of praying about?

Excellent Brainstormers|Giving.recognize: You come up with ways to meet a need that money alone would not have solved, and your solution often fits better. The exposure is that the interesting solution takes six weeks and cash would have taken a day.
Excellent Brainstormers|Giving.ask: Who waited while you designed something better?

Excellent Brainstormers|Healing.recognize: You find another approach when the obvious one has failed, and for a stuck situation that is everything. What it can skip is the person who needed the same thing tried again patiently.
Excellent Brainstormers|Healing.ask: What did you stop trying too early?

Excellent Brainstormers|Interpretation.recognize: You can offer several readings of a confusing situation, which keeps a group from locking onto the first. The risk is a room that leaves with more possibilities than it arrived with.
Excellent Brainstormers|Interpretation.ask: What did your last meeting conclude?

Excellent Brainstormers|Knowledge.recognize: You put what you know together in combinations nobody else would try, and some of them are genuinely new. The waste is that most were never followed far enough to find out.
Excellent Brainstormers|Knowledge.ask: Which of your ideas has anyone ever tested?

Excellent Brainstormers|Leadership.recognize: Your team is never short of options, and a group who believes there is always another way does not give up easily. The exposure is that people cannot execute a plan that keeps being improved.
Excellent Brainstormers|Leadership.ask: What has your team started three times?

Excellent Brainstormers|Mercy.recognize: You think of things to do for somebody in trouble that would occur to nobody else, and those are often what they remember. The limit is that suffering does not need to be solved cleverly, only accompanied.
Excellent Brainstormers|Mercy.ask: When did you last simply sit there?

Excellent Brainstormers|Miracles.recognize: You are open to God working in ways you have not seen described, which is a wider door than most people leave open. Worth examining is whether the possibilities interest you more than He does.
Excellent Brainstormers|Miracles.ask: Which of the two are you more drawn to?

Excellent Brainstormers|Pastor/Shepherd.recognize: You find a way to reach somebody who has stopped responding to the usual approaches, and some people are only reached like that. The cost is the person who needs the same predictable care every week.

Excellent Brainstormers|Prophecy.recognize: You can see several things that might be wrong here, which makes you slower to accuse than most. The risk is raising all of them and letting the room pick.
Excellent Brainstormers|Prophecy.ask: Which one did you actually believe?

Excellent Brainstormers|Service.recognize: You find a way to get the job done when the usual way is unavailable, and that resourcefulness has saved events. The friction is redesigning a job that only needed doing.
Excellent Brainstormers|Service.ask: What did you improvise that had a working method?

Excellent Brainstormers|Teaching.recognize: You can come at the same thing five ways until one of them lands, and that reaches students other teachers lose. The risk is a class that has heard five versions and holds none.

Excellent Brainstormers|Tongues.recognize: You are comfortable with what takes many forms and has no single description, and that openness fits this ground. What deserves attention is whether you are exploring rather than participating.
Excellent Brainstormers|Tongues.ask: When did you last stop thinking about it and enter it?

Excellent Brainstormers|Wisdom.recognize: You can put more possibilities in front of a decision than anybody else, and a person with one option has no real choice. The limit is that eventually somebody has to close the list.
Excellent Brainstormers|Wisdom.ask: Who closes the list for you?

Excellent Communicators|Administration.recognize: You can lay out a process so well that people adopt it without a fight, and that saves months of argument. What can happen is the meeting where you presented it beautifully and nobody mentioned the hole in it.
Excellent Communicators|Administration.ask: Who kept an objection to themselves in your last meeting?

Excellent Communicators|Apostleship.recognize: You can make a work that does not exist yet sound like somewhere people want to be, and that is how a new thing gets its first twelve. The risk is that your description keeps recruiting after the reality stopped matching it.
Excellent Communicators|Apostleship.ask: Who joined for the version you described rather than the one they found?

Excellent Communicators|Discernment.recognize: You put words to what everyone in the room half-noticed, and the relief when you do is real. What follows is that your wording becomes what happened, including the parts you guessed at.
Excellent Communicators|Discernment.ask: What did you say happened that you were guessing at?

Excellent Communicators|Evangelism.recognize: You can talk about Jesus in a way that holds a stranger's attention for twenty minutes, which almost nobody manages. Worth watching is whether they were moved by Him or by how well it was said.
Excellent Communicators|Evangelism.ask: When did somebody thank you for the talk and never come back?

Excellent Communicators|Exhortation.recognize: You say the thing that gets a stuck person moving again, and they can quote you years later. The weight of that is that your line keeps working on them long after the situation changed.
Excellent Communicators|Exhortation.ask: Whose life is still shaped by something you no longer believe?

Excellent Communicators|Faith.recognize: You can make trusting God sound reasonable to people who find it absurd, and that has kept some of them in the room. The gap is that your account is always more settled than your week actually was.
Excellent Communicators|Faith.ask: What did you describe as steady while you were falling apart?

Excellent Communicators|Giving.recognize: You can make a need vivid enough that people open their wallets, and real money has moved because of you. What to watch is a story sharpened past what the family in it would recognise.
Excellent Communicators|Giving.ask: Whose story did you tell better than they lived it?

Excellent Communicators|Healing.recognize: You give somebody language for what they went through, and being understood out loud is itself medicine. What it can skip is the quiet that was doing its own work.
Excellent Communicators|Healing.ask: Who got your words before they wanted any?

Excellent Communicators|Interpretation.recognize: You take a muddled account and give it back clean, and people believe the clean one because it was said well. Whatever did not fit quietly stops being part of the story.
Excellent Communicators|Interpretation.ask: What detail keeps getting left out when you retell it?

Excellent Communicators|Knowledge.recognize: You can make a difficult subject sound obvious, which is why people ask you rather than reading it themselves. The exposure is a room confident in something none of them studied.
Excellent Communicators|Knowledge.ask: Who repeats your explanation as if it were their own reading?

Excellent Communicators|Leadership.recognize: You can put a goal into words that make people want it, and wanting it is most of the battle. What gets skipped is the argument, because arguing with you rarely goes well for the other person.
Excellent Communicators|Leadership.ask: Who stopped disagreeing with you out loud?

Excellent Communicators|Mercy.recognize: You can be with somebody in pain and say the right thing at the right moment, and they carry that sentence for years. The limit is grief that wants no sentence at all.
Excellent Communicators|Mercy.ask: Whose grief did you try to put into words?

Excellent Communicators|Miracles.recognize: You can describe what God has done so a skeptical room leans in rather than checking out, and that is a service to the account itself. Worth asking is whether the telling has grown in the retelling.
Excellent Communicators|Miracles.ask: Which detail has gotten bigger each time you told it?

Excellent Communicators|Pastor/Shepherd.recognize: People feel known after ten minutes with you, because you can say back what they meant better than they said it. The question is whether you have stayed long enough to be wrong about anyone yet.
Excellent Communicators|Pastor/Shepherd.ask: Who have you understood quickly and never revisited?

Excellent Communicators|Prophecy.recognize: You can say a hard thing so it is heard rather than resisted, which is rarer than the hard thing itself. The risk is polishing it until it is admired instead of obeyed.
Excellent Communicators|Prophecy.ask: What did people call powerful and then ignore?

Excellent Communicators|Service.recognize: You can rally a room to a job in five minutes, and the job gets staffed. Where it goes thin is the stretch after the speech, when the work is dull and nobody is listening to anyone.
Excellent Communicators|Service.ask: What did you recruit for and not stay for?

Excellent Communicators|Teaching.recognize: You hold a class awake for an hour on material that should not survive twenty minutes. The measure is not whether they enjoyed it but whether they could teach it to somebody else on Sunday.
Excellent Communicators|Teaching.ask: Who could teach your last lesson back to you?

Excellent Communicators|Tongues.recognize: You can describe spiritual experience without making it sound strange, which opens a door for people who would otherwise back away. The risk is that whatever you cannot put well stops counting as real to you.
Excellent Communicators|Tongues.ask: What has happened to you that you have no words for?

Excellent Communicators|Wisdom.recognize: Your advice gets taken because of how it arrives, not only because it is right, and that doubles its reach. The exposure is guidance that was half-formed and still persuasive.
Excellent Communicators|Wisdom.ask: What did somebody act on that you had not thought all the way through?

Excellent Organizers|Administration.recognize: You can run six moving parts at once and none of them collide, which is why the large things get handed to you. What creeps in is a system with more parts than the job has, kept alive because it is yours.
Excellent Organizers|Administration.ask: What are you still maintaining that nobody would rebuild today?

Excellent Organizers|Apostleship.recognize: You can stand up a new work with real scaffolding under it, so it survives its second year. The risk is scaffolding poured before anyone knows the shape of the thing.
Excellent Organizers|Apostleship.ask: What did you write down as policy in the first month?

Excellent Organizers|Discernment.recognize: You can look at a team and see where the work will jam, usually weeks ahead. Where it misfires is a person treated as a bottleneck when they were actually struggling.
Excellent Organizers|Discernment.ask: Who did you route around instead of asking about?

Excellent Organizers|Evangelism.recognize: You can take a first-time visitor from the parking lot to a small group without a single gap, and few churches manage it. Watch for a journey so mapped that nothing in it is allowed to be unplanned.
Excellent Organizers|Evangelism.ask: What in your process leaves room for God to interrupt?

Excellent Organizers|Exhortation.recognize: You give a stuck person a plan with dates on it, and the dates are usually what gets them moving. What a plan cannot do is address why they stopped.
Excellent Organizers|Exhortation.ask: Who took your plan and stalled at the same place again?

Excellent Organizers|Faith.recognize: You lay the groundwork so a bold decision has something to land on, and that has saved more than one venture. The examination is whether you require the groundwork before you will obey.
Excellent Organizers|Faith.ask: What did you postpone until the details were settled?

Excellent Organizers|Giving.recognize: Your generosity is scheduled, tracked and it arrives, which puts you ahead of nearly everyone who merely intends to be generous. The narrow part is the need that turns up outside the schedule.
Excellent Organizers|Giving.ask: Who asked you for help in a month you had already allocated?

Excellent Organizers|Healing.recognize: You arrange everything around a person in crisis so their life keeps running while they cannot run it, and that is enormous. What no arrangement covers is the year afterward, when the meals have stopped.
Excellent Organizers|Healing.ask: Who did you carry through a crisis and lose track of after?

Excellent Organizers|Interpretation.recognize: You can lay a confusing situation out on a page with the pieces labelled, and suddenly people can talk about it. The risk is that the page becomes the situation, and whatever would not fit a box gets dropped.
Excellent Organizers|Interpretation.ask: What would not fit on the page?

Excellent Organizers|Knowledge.recognize: You keep what you learn where other people can find it, which is rarer and more useful than the learning itself. The trap is spending more effort on the filing than on the finding.
Excellent Organizers|Knowledge.ask: What have you catalogued and never once used?

Excellent Organizers|Leadership.recognize: Nothing on your team falls between two people, because you assigned the space between them. What can go missing is initiative, since a role this well defined does not require anyone to think.
Excellent Organizers|Leadership.ask: Who on your team last did something you had not assigned?

Excellent Organizers|Mercy.recognize: You turn care into a rota so it keeps happening after week two, and most goodwill dies in week two. What a rota cannot schedule is the friend who shows up unannounced.
Excellent Organizers|Mercy.ask: Who needed you at an hour that was not on the list?

Excellent Organizers|Miracles.recognize: You get everything ready so that when God moves there is a room, a team and a follow-up. Worth weighing is whether readiness has quietly become your requirement.
Excellent Organizers|Miracles.ask: What have you not prayed for because you could not staff it?

Excellent Organizers|Pastor/Shepherd.recognize: Nobody in your care is unaccounted for, and past forty people that is only possible because you made something to hold them. What a system holds is names, not the person behind one of them.
Excellent Organizers|Pastor/Shepherd.ask: Which name on your list have you not actually spoken to this month?

Excellent Organizers|Prophecy.recognize: You lay out a hard reality with the evidence arranged so it cannot be argued with, and that has forced necessary decisions. The cost is that unarguable and received are not the same thing.
Excellent Organizers|Prophecy.ask: Who agreed with your case and changed nothing?

Excellent Organizers|Service.recognize: You can put thirty volunteers where they are needed with nobody idle and nobody doubled up. The friction is the volunteer who came for the company and got a slot.
Excellent Organizers|Service.ask: Who was placed perfectly and still went home lonely?

Excellent Organizers|Teaching.recognize: Your material is sequenced so a person can actually get from the first week to the last, which most teaching never bothers to do. The risk is a syllabus so complete that no question can move it.
Excellent Organizers|Teaching.ask: When did a question last change your lesson mid-session?

Excellent Organizers|Tongues.recognize: You can hold a service where unusual things happen without it descending into chaos, and that keeps everyone in the room safe. The question is whether the container has become tight enough that nothing unplanned could get in.
Excellent Organizers|Tongues.ask: What did you shut down because it was not on the sheet?

Excellent Organizers|Wisdom.recognize: You give people a sequence rather than an opinion, and a sequence is usable on Monday. The limit is the decision that has no steps in it, only a cost somebody has to accept.
Excellent Organizers|Wisdom.ask: What did you break into steps that was really one hard choice?

Excellent People Skills|Administration.recognize: You get compliance without resentment, because people do what you ask for reasons that feel like their own. Worth examining is whether that is leadership or a technique you have gotten very good at.
Excellent People Skills|Administration.ask: Who agreed to something last week because of how you asked?

Excellent People Skills|Apostleship.recognize: You can walk into an unfamiliar community and have real relationships inside a month, which is the whole first phase of new work. The exposure is that a month of warmth is not yet trust.
Excellent People Skills|Apostleship.ask: Who knows you well enough to tell you no?

Excellent People Skills|Discernment.recognize: You read what a person is protecting within minutes of meeting them, and you are usually right. The question is what you do with it, because the same read serves care and advantage equally well.
Excellent People Skills|Discernment.ask: When did you last use what you read about somebody to get something?

Excellent People Skills|Evangelism.recognize: People say yes to you, which is why you get asked to make the ask. What is hard to see from inside is whether they said yes to Jesus or to a person they did not want to let down.
Excellent People Skills|Evangelism.ask: Whose yes do you quietly doubt now?

Excellent People Skills|Exhortation.recognize: You know how much challenge a particular person can take, and you deliver it at exactly that weight. The risk is calibrating down for somebody who could have taken more.
Excellent People Skills|Exhortation.ask: Who did you go easy on this month?

Excellent People Skills|Faith.recognize: You keep a group together when the situation is uncertain, because you attend to each of them one at a time. What can hide inside that is a group held by you rather than by God.
Excellent People Skills|Faith.ask: What would hold your people together if you left?

Excellent People Skills|Giving.recognize: You give in ways that fit the person exactly, so it lands as care and not charity, and that is a real skill. Worth weighing is what comes back to you in warmth, and whether you noticed it arriving.
Excellent People Skills|Giving.ask: What came back to you the last time you gave?

Excellent People Skills|Healing.recognize: You make a hurting person feel safe enough to talk, and most recovery waits on that. The limit is that being good at the opening does not qualify you for what comes out of it.
Excellent People Skills|Healing.ask: Who told you something you were not equipped to carry?

Excellent People Skills|Interpretation.recognize: You can stand between two people who have stopped hearing each other and get them talking again. The danger is a peace you brokered that neither of them actually holds.
Excellent People Skills|Interpretation.ask: Which reconciliation did you arrange that has not held?

Excellent People Skills|Knowledge.recognize: People tell you things, so you know more about your church than almost anyone. That came to you as trust, and it can be spent without ever being recorded as spent.
Excellent People Skills|Knowledge.ask: What have you repeated that was told to you in confidence?

Excellent People Skills|Leadership.recognize: You get a difficult group aligned by working them one at a time before the meeting, and it works every time. The cost is that the meeting is now theatre and the real decision happened where nobody could challenge it.
Excellent People Skills|Leadership.ask: What was decided before your last meeting started?

Excellent People Skills|Mercy.recognize: You know how to sit with somebody in pain without making it about you, which many kind people never learn. Where it thins is the person whose pain has made them unpleasant.
Excellent People Skills|Mercy.ask: Who is hurting in a way that is hard to like?

Excellent People Skills|Miracles.recognize: People who would have walked out of an unusual meeting stay because you are in it, and that is worth something real. The question is whether your presence is settling them or standing in for what they came to meet.
Excellent People Skills|Miracles.ask: When did you last need God in a room you could already work?

Excellent People Skills|Pastor/Shepherd.recognize: You maintain more real relationships than most people can manage, and each one gets something genuine. What that many relationships cannot include is the two or three that would cost you.
Excellent People Skills|Pastor/Shepherd.ask: Which relationship of yours has actually cost you?

Excellent People Skills|Prophecy.recognize: You can say a difficult thing to somebody in a way they can receive, which is the difference between being right and being useful. The risk is choosing hearable over necessary every single time.
Excellent People Skills|Prophecy.ask: Whose good opinion of you has cost them something honest?

Excellent People Skills|Service.recognize: Your teams come back, because working with you is worth the Saturday. Worth checking is whether they return for the work or for you, and what happens the week you are away.
Excellent People Skills|Service.ask: Who showed up the last time you were not there?

Excellent People Skills|Teaching.recognize: You read the room and change course before anyone glazes over, so your material actually lands. The risk is dropping the part that made them uncomfortable because you felt the room go tense.
Excellent People Skills|Teaching.ask: What have you stopped teaching because it made people tense?

Excellent People Skills|Tongues.recognize: You are at ease in spiritual settings that make other people awkward, and your ease makes them less awkward. The question is whether you have ever been undone in one.
Excellent People Skills|Tongues.ask: When were you last out of your depth with God?

Excellent People Skills|Wisdom.recognize: You say the hard thing at the moment a person can take it, and that patience is what makes your advice usable. The trap is a perfect moment that keeps not arriving.
Excellent People Skills|Wisdom.ask: What have you been waiting to say for more than a year?

Future Focused|Administration.recognize: You are already making the process the church will need at twice its size, and when it gets there the process exists. The cost lands now, on people carrying weight for a load that has not arrived.
Future Focused|Administration.ask: What are your people doing today for a problem you do not have yet?

Future Focused|Apostleship.recognize: You can see which neighbourhood will need a church three years out, and being early is most of that work. The pattern to watch is arriving early and leaving before the slow middle.
Future Focused|Apostleship.ask: Where are you now that you will not be in two years?

Future Focused|Discernment.recognize: You can tell where a person is heading, not only where they are, and you are often right about the destination. What that costs is the version of them standing in front of you now.
Future Focused|Discernment.ask: Who have you already decided how this ends for?

Future Focused|Evangelism.recognize: You are thinking about somebody's next five years rather than this conversation, which keeps you patient where others push. The gap is that a plan for a person is not the same as time with them.
Future Focused|Evangelism.ask: Who are you being patient with and not actually seeing?

Future Focused|Exhortation.recognize: You can show somebody what they will be capable of in two years, and that picture pulls them through a hard season. The risk is that they hear it as who they should already be.
Future Focused|Exhortation.ask: Who left a conversation with you feeling behind?

Future Focused|Faith.recognize: You commit to things whose payoff is years out, which is exactly the obedience most people talk themselves out of. Worth examining is whether the long view has become a way to defer what is available today.
Future Focused|Faith.ask: What is in front of you today that your plan has no room for?

Future Focused|Giving.recognize: You fund things whose return arrives long after the giving, which is how endowments and buildings and scholarships happen at all. The narrow part is the person who needs rent this month.
Future Focused|Giving.ask: Who needed something from you this week and got nothing?

Future Focused|Healing.recognize: You can hold out a picture of life after this to somebody in the middle of it, and that picture has kept people alive. What it can skip is that today still has to be survived on its own terms.
Future Focused|Healing.ask: Who did you talk about next year with when they were barely through the day?

Future Focused|Interpretation.recognize: You read current events as the early part of a pattern, and you are often right about where the pattern goes. The danger is a reading so confident that this week gets treated as a footnote to it.
Future Focused|Interpretation.ask: What are you certain about that has not happened yet?

Future Focused|Knowledge.recognize: You study what is about to matter rather than what already does, which puts you years ahead on the right subjects. The exposure is being ahead on everything and current on nothing.
Future Focused|Knowledge.ask: What is happening right now that you have not looked into?

Future Focused|Leadership.recognize: You move an organization toward something that does not exist yet, and organizations rarely move without somebody like that. The gap is a team following a destination they have never been shown clearly enough to want.
Future Focused|Leadership.ask: Which of your people is walking without knowing where?

Future Focused|Mercy.recognize: You can promise somebody that this will not always be the shape of their life, and sometimes that promise is the only thing holding. The limit is grief, which does not want to hear about later.
Future Focused|Mercy.ask: Who wanted you to stay in today with them?

Future Focused|Miracles.recognize: You pray for things far enough out that you would not see them for years, which is a rare kind of trust. Worth asking is whether anything you are asking God for could be answered this month.
Future Focused|Miracles.ask: What are you praying about that has a date on it?

Future Focused|Pastor/Shepherd.recognize: You see who a person could become and you steward them toward it, which is why several people owe their path to you. What can be missed is the one who is not going anywhere and needs care anyway.
Future Focused|Pastor/Shepherd.ask: Who in your care has no potential you are developing?

Future Focused|Prophecy.recognize: You name where a decision leads before anyone else has followed the line that far, and more than once you have been proven right. The cost of being early is that you are dismissed first and vindicated too late to help.
Future Focused|Prophecy.ask: What did you warn about that nobody remembers you saying?

Future Focused|Service.recognize: You prepare for the work that is coming rather than the work in front of you, so your ministry is never caught flat. The friction is the room that needed cleaning today while you were setting up for autumn.
Future Focused|Service.ask: What ordinary job did you skip because it was not strategic?

Future Focused|Teaching.recognize: You teach people what they will need rather than what they asked about, and a year later they discover you were right. The risk is a class full of answers to questions nobody has yet.
Future Focused|Teaching.ask: What did somebody ask you that you never got around to answering?

Future Focused|Tongues.recognize: You are at peace with a faith that is still unfolding and do not need everything settled today. What is worth testing is whether you are ever fully present in a room you are already past.
Future Focused|Tongues.ask: What did you miss today because you were in next year?

Future Focused|Wisdom.recognize: Your advice accounts for consequences three moves out, which is why people who take it rarely regret it. The limit is the person who needed help with tonight.
Future Focused|Wisdom.ask: Who came to you about today and left with a five-year plan?

Generous|Administration.recognize: You give your time to whatever process is broken, so things get fixed that were nobody's job. What follows is a calendar made entirely out of other people's gaps.
Generous|Administration.ask: What is on your calendar this week that you never agreed to?

Generous|Apostleship.recognize: You fund and staff a new thing before it has proved anything, which is the only way new things ever start. The exposure is three of them at once and none of them fed.
Generous|Apostleship.ask: Which of the things you started is starving right now?

Generous|Discernment.recognize: You give people the benefit of the doubt as a default, and you have been right about people everyone else had written off. The cost is that you keep giving to the one you had a bad feeling about.
Generous|Discernment.ask: Who are you still helping against your own judgement?

Generous|Evangelism.recognize: You give before you say anything, so by the time faith comes up you have earned the hearing. Watch for generosity that becomes the whole relationship because the words never quite arrive.
Generous|Evangelism.ask: Who have you helped for two years and never spoken to about Christ?

Generous|Exhortation.recognize: You give people credit freely, including credit you could have kept, and they grow under it. The risk is credit handed out so freely that it stops carrying information.
Generous|Exhortation.ask: Who did you praise for work that was not actually good?

Generous|Faith.recognize: You let go of money and time before you can see how it gets replaced, and it usually is. Worth examining is whether it gets replaced by God or by you working an extra job to cover it.
Generous|Faith.ask: Who in your household absorbed your last big gift?

Generous|Giving.recognize: This is the one where your instinct and your gift agree, so you rarely hesitate, and a great deal has moved because of it. The examination is whether anything you gave lately was actually difficult.
Generous|Giving.ask: What did you say no to giving this year?

Generous|Healing.recognize: You give somebody in crisis whatever you have on you, and that immediacy is often what carries them through the first week. The pattern to watch is emptying yourself for a recovery that takes eighteen months.
Generous|Healing.ask: What do you have left for the person you are helping now?

Generous|Interpretation.recognize: You give people the most charitable reading of what was said, and a lot of conflict never starts because of it. The danger is a charitable reading applied to something that was said on purpose.
Generous|Interpretation.ask: What did you explain away that was actually intended?

Generous|Knowledge.recognize: You give away what you know without needing to be the one who knows it, which makes you unusually easy to learn from. What can go is your own study, because everything you find leaves the building immediately.
Generous|Knowledge.ask: When did you last learn something for yourself alone?

Generous|Leadership.recognize: You give your people room, resources and the credit, and they stay for years because of it. The gap is the correction you also owe them, which generosity is a comfortable reason to postpone.
Generous|Leadership.ask: Who on your team is overdue for a hard conversation?

Generous|Mercy.recognize: Nobody in front of you goes without, because you would rather go without yourself. The limit is that some people need a boundary from you more than they need another gift.
Generous|Mercy.ask: Who have you helped so often they stopped trying?
